title: Equality before law
description: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

title: Prohibition of discrimination
description: The State shall not discriminate against any citizen on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, or any of them.

title: Equality of opportunity in public employment
description: There shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State.

title: Freedoms under Article 19(1)
description: Citizens have freedoms including speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and profession, subject to reasonable restrictions.

title: Protection in respect of conviction for offences
description: No ex post facto criminal law, no double jeopardy, and no compelled self-incrimination.

title: Protection of life and personal liberty
description: No person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

title: Right to education
description: The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age six to fourteen years.

title: Protection against arbitrary arrest and detention
description: Provides safeguards in cases of arrest and detention, including right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner.

title: Freedom of conscience and religion
description: All persons are equally entitled to freedom of conscience and the right to freely profess, practice and propagate religion, subject to public order, morality and health.

title: Freedom to manage religious affairs
description: Every religious denomination has rights to manage its own affairs in matters of religion, subject to public order, morality and health.

title: Protection of interests of minorities
description: Any section of citizens with distinct language, script, or culture has the right to conserve the same.

title: Right of minorities to establish educational institutions
description: Minorities, whether based on religion or language, have the right to establish and administer educational institutions.

title: Constitutional remedies
description: Right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights, including writ jurisdiction.

title: Equal justice and free legal aid
description: The State shall secure that the operation of the legal system promotes justice and shall provide free legal aid to ensure equal opportunity.

title: Separation of judiciary from executive
description: The State shall take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in public services of the State.

title: President's pardoning power
description: President's power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions of punishment and to suspend, remit or commute sentences in specified cases.

title: Special leave to appeal by Supreme Court
description: Supreme Court may grant special leave to appeal from any judgment, decree, determination, sentence or order.

title: Law declared by Supreme Court
description: The law declared by the Supreme Court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India.

title: Complete justice power
description: Supreme Court may pass such decree or make such order as is necessary for doing complete justice in any cause or matter pending before it.

title: High Courts writ jurisdiction
description: High Courts have power to issue writs for enforcement of fundamental rights and for any other purpose.

title: Superintendence of High Courts
description: Every High Court shall have superintendence over all courts and tribunals throughout the territories in relation to which it exercises jurisdiction.

title: Right to property as constitutional right
description: No person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law.
chapter: Part XII - Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits

title: Dismissal, removal or reduction in rank
description: Safeguards for civil servants against dismissal, removal or reduction in rank without inquiry, subject to exceptions.
chapter: Part XIV - Services Under the Union and the States

title: Amendment of the Constitution
description: Procedure and power of Parliament to amend the Constitution.
chapter: Part XX - Amendment of the Constitution
